items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 2 Dec (UK only). Welcome to the Freak Zone, 6 Music's home for all the weird and wonderful music you didn't know you needed to hear. This week there's math rock and wonky pop, groovy sounds from Turkey and Nigeria, top tunes from Brian, Keith and Vashti, and Purcell played by a pair of top Norwegian jazzers. Plus, Stuart's featured album is Robbie Basho's masterpiece of American primitive guitar Visions of the Country.
items.title: Robbie Basho's Visions of the Country

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 25 Nov (UK only). Stuart gets spooky and supernatural for All Hallows Eve. Expect werewolves, demons, witches and a blasphemous seal. There's music from Keith Emerson, Sun Ra and France Gall plus live advice from an LA witch.
items.title: The Freak Zone Halloween Special

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 18 Nov (UK only). Stuart's featured album is Glenn Branca's 1981 debut album The Ascension - a no-wave classic and landmark in experimental guitar music, based around layering electric guitars in alternate tunings. Also in this week's roundup of adventurous and avant-garde music, some Donegal art-rock, Brightonian folk-noir, a bonus segment from Stuart's interview with The Pet Shop Boys, and Stuart reads your correspondence.
items.title: Glenn Branca - The Ascension

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 11 Nov (UK only). Stuart marks Slow Sunday with a special autumnal playlist. Celebrate the season of mists and mellow fruitfulness in Freak Zone style with music from Matt Berry, Lee Hazelwood and the Incredible String Band, plus Mancunian jazz, Italian prog, English doom metal and a touch of Frank Sinatra.
items.title: Slow Sunday; Autumn, season of mists and mellow fruitfulness and all that
